## Why visit

A serious cask-and-cider stop for an optional Huddersfield day. The pub has an individual, decorated interior and the Rat brewery beneath it, with a broader family of Ossett beers providing plenty to compare. Dark beer drinkers have a particularly good reason to look at the board. Combine it with the Sportsman for an excursion built around two different pub settings and substantial cider possibilities. It is less useful as a rushed single stop from Manchester, so give the journey a clear purpose and allow time to enjoy the beer rather than simply changing trains.

## Beer

CAMRA reports nine handpumps, mainly Ossett-family beers, with dark ales commonly available; official site confirms the onsite Rat brewery.

## Plan the visit

Operator says walk-ins rather than table bookings. Any brewery visit/tour needs a separate arrangement; pub entry does not include it.

**Getting there:** Walk across Huddersfield centre from the station; pair with the Sportsman if choosing this extended day.
